nas.title: National Accounts Statistics
nas.note: Base 2022-23. Latest years are provisional and get revised.

gsdp.title: State Domestic Product
gsdp.note: Base 2011-12, so not directly comparable with the 2022-23 national series. Assam, Haryana and Nagaland are not available through MoSPI's API.

gsva.title: Gross State Value Added by industry
gsva.note: Base 2011-12. Converted from ₹ lakh to ₹ crore. Assam, Haryana and Nagaland are not available through MoSPI's API.

iip.title: Index of Industrial Production
iip.note: Base 2022-23. Growth is year on year as published.

isp.title: Index of Service Production
isp.note: Base 2024-25. Growth is year on year as published.

plfs.title: Periodic Labour Force Survey
plfs.note: Persons aged 15+, rural and urban combined, usual status (PS+SS), calendar year.

asi.title: Annual Survey of Industries
asi.note: Registered factories only, NIC 2008, so it excludes small informal units. Converted from ₹ lakh to ₹ crore. Values can be withheld where few factories report.

rbi_trade.title: India's foreign trade
rbi_trade.note: US$ million. MoSPI's copy of this RBI series lags; check the latest period shown.

rbi_fx.title: Foreign exchange reserves
rbi_fx.note: US$ million. MoSPI's copy of this RBI series lags; check the latest period shown.

ccs_urban.title: Urban Consumer Confidence Survey
ccs_urban.note: Households in major cities. Net response = share saying improved minus share saying worsened (for prices, increased minus decreased, so negative means more expect prices to rise).

ccs_rural.title: Rural Consumer Confidence Survey
ccs_rural.note: Rural and semi-urban households. Indices above 100 mean more households are optimistic than pessimistic.

ipi_sdg.title: India Policy Insights: SDG estimates by state, district and village
ipi_sdg.note: Model-based estimates from NFHS-5 and the 2011 Census for 35 SDG indicators, rural villages. CC0. Rebuilt only on request.

rbi_commodity.title: Exports and imports of major commodities
rbi_commodity.note: US$ million, financial year. National only: this series has no state split.
